name: StudentD
cognitive_state: Weak foundational math knowledge, with mastery around 50%.
Highly sensitive to mistakes and gives up easily.
Lacks learning strategies and relies on rote memorization.
affective_state: Low motivation and frequent feelings of helplessness.
Anxious about exam performance and afraid of comparisons.
Responds strongly to positive teacher feedback and needs external recognition for motivation.

perception: Likes teacher demonstrations but struggles to complete tasks independently.
processing: Fears mistakes and dislikes speaking in groups.
understanding: Needs explicit steps and struggles to skip intermediate steps.

common_mistakes: Memorizes formulas without understanding principles and cannot solve slightly altered math questions.
Hesitates out of fear of mistakes, often leaving questions blank or stopping halfway through.
Relies on teacher examples and struggles to transfer knowledge to new questions independently.
Sequential thinking makes it difficult to continue when an intermediate step is missing.
Exam anxiety impairs performance, often below the usual level.
Rote memorization is easily forgotten; cannot derive the material again once it is forgotten.
